fato_historico: -30: Mark Antony wins a final cavalry battle against Octavian in the battle of Alexandria, but his infantry is defeated and the next day his fleet and troops start to desert to Octavian.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a shifting tide, much like ancient battles where persistence mattered more than the outcome. Consider how you handle internal conflicts; even if some paths seem to desert you, your soul remains undefeated. It is a good time to embrace the currents of change and find beauty in the quiet resilience of your spirit.
frase_do_dia: Your gentle strength is the anchor in every storm you choose to navigate today.
significado_numero: Represents the intuition and cycles of the moon guiding your path forward.
conselho: Trust the ebb and flow of life rather than fighting against the changing tide.
